sentences.en: Good morning, Mr. West. Nice to have you on our program.
sentences.zh: 早上好，韦斯特先生。很高兴请您参加我们的节目。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: OK. We all work or very few people can get away with not working.
sentences.zh: 我们都需要工作，或者说，只有极少数人可以不工作而照样生活。

w.m: phr.做……而不受影响；得以蒙混过关

sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Work is a fact of life when we’re adults.
sentences.zh: 成年以后，工作就是生活中必须面对的现实。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: But before, there wasn’t a lot of choice in the selection of work.
sentences.zh: 但在过去，人们择业时并没有多少选择。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Now things are different.
sentences.zh: 现在情况不同了。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: With greater mobility, the mobility that is offered when people have greater opportunities for higher education or training, more and more people are able to choose the fields that interest them.
sentences.zh: 当人们获得更多接受高等教育或培训的机会时，流动性也随之增强，越来越多的人因此能够选择自己感兴趣的领域。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: They can and do have opinions about what makes one job for them better than another job.
sentences.zh: 他们能够，而且也确实会判断：对自己来说，什么使一份工作比另一份更好。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: So, Mr. West, what do people actually want from their jobs?
sentences.zh: 那么，韦斯特先生，人们究竟希望从工作中获得什么呢？
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: What are workers’ opinions, you know, about what makes one job better than another?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，劳动者如何看待一份工作胜过另一份工作的原因？
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Well, to answer your questions, I’d like to look at two polls, two surveys.
sentences.zh: 要回答您的问题，我想介绍两项民意调查。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: They were both done in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 两项调查都是在二十世纪九十年代开展的。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: The purposes were to find out what issues or job characteristics were especially important to workers.
sentences.zh: 调查目的是了解，哪些问题或工作特点对劳动者来说尤其重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Umm. What were they?
sentences.zh: 那么，具体是哪些呢？

w.m: phr.那具体是哪些（追问前文提到的项目）

sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Some of you might guess that the answer is obvious.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会觉得，答案显而易见。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么想。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: You might say “oh people just want higher salaries, more money.”
sentences.zh: 您可能会说：“人们无非就是想要更高的工资、更多的钱。”
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: But let’s see if that’s true.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们来看看事实是否如此。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Now, the first poll.
sentences.zh: 先来看第一项调查。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: The first poll was taken in 1990, and this poll asked respondents to choose what was the most important to them among five items.
sentences.zh: 第一项调查开展于一九九〇年，要求受访者从五个项目中选出对自己最重要的一项。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And they were only allowed to choose one out of the five items.
sentences.zh: 五个项目中，他们只能选一个。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: So what were the five items?
sentences.zh: 那么，这五个项目是什么呢？
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Alright. The first item was important and meaningful work.
sentences.zh: 第一项，是工作重要且有意义。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: The second was high income.
sentences.zh: 第二项，是高收入。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: The third was chances for advancement, promotion and so on.
sentences.zh: 第三项，是职业发展、晋升等机会。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: The fourth item was job security, and the fifth was shorter work hours, OK?
sentences.zh: 第四项，是工作稳定有保障；第五项，是工作时间更短。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: It would be interesting to know the survey results.
sentences.zh: 我很想了解调查结果。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Yes, now let me tell you the results.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我来介绍结果。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: 50% considered important and meaningful work the most important characteristic of a job.
sentences.zh: 百分之五十的人认为，工作重要且有意义是最重要的工作特点。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: They didn’t choose high income.
sentences.zh: 他们没有选择高收入。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 很有意思。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Anyway, 24% did say high income was the most important characteristic of a job.
sentences.zh: 而百分之二十四的人确实认为，高收入是工作最重要的特点。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Of the remaining, 16% said chances for advancement was most important.
sentences.zh: 在其余的人中，百分之十六认为晋升机会最重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Maybe these were younger workers, starting out on a career.
sentences.zh: 这些人也许是刚开始职业生涯的年轻劳动者。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: 6% said job security and finally 4% said shorter work hours was most important.
sentences.zh: 百分之六的人认为工作保障最重要，最后还有百分之四的人选择了更短的工作时间。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: I think what’s striking about the results is that by far workers valued important and meaningful work as more important than any of the other characteristics, that included salary.
sentences.zh: 我觉得结果最引人注目的地方在于，劳动者认为工作重要且有意义，远比其他任何特点都重要，其中也包括工资。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Yeah. Now I’m going to tell you about another poll, and this poll was taken a year later in 1991, and it asked the respondents to reflect on how important certain job characteristics were in their work.
sentences.zh: 下面再介绍另一项调查。这项调查在一年后，也就是一九九一年开展，要求受访者考虑某些工作特点对自己究竟有多重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And this is a different type of poll because whereas in the first poll, respondents had to choose only one out of five, in this poll they wanted their respondents to react to each item separately.
sentences.zh: 这项调查的类型不同：第一项调查要求受访者五选一，而这项调查则要求他们逐项分别作答。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: You know, this is to rank each item as “not important”, “somewhat important”, “important” or “very important”.
sentences.zh: 也就是把每个项目评为“不重要”“有些重要”“重要”或“非常重要”。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: So they have four choices for each item.
sentences.zh: 因此，每一项都有四个选项。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: How can the relationship between choice and mobility be best indicated?
sentences.zh: 哪种表述最能体现择业选择与流动性之间的关系？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: According to the interview, what detail about the first poll is INCORRECT?
sentences.zh: 根据采访，关于第一项调查的哪项细节不正确？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: Which came second for being the most important issue for workers in the first poll?
sentences.zh: 在第一项调查中，劳动者最看重的因素中，哪一项排名第二？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: According to Mr. West, what’s the main difference between the two polls?
sentences.zh: 根据韦斯特先生的介绍，两项调查的主要区别是什么？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: How many choices were there for each item in the second poll?
sentences.zh: 第二项调查的每个项目有几个选项？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer
